arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler argued the lower court's nationwide ban violated Article III standing principles.
Mr. Kenna argued a facial challenge is valid if the rule applies to plaintiffs.
Justice Souter questioned the standard for showing a specific threatened injury.
Justice Breyer asked if Congress can authorize general challenges to agency rules.
